# Centrium

> Centrium by QuadCore SAS is a SaaS platform for staffing agencies (ESN) and consulting firms. It centralizes consultant management, AI CV optimization, RFP responses, sales pipeline, timesheets and invoicing into one workflow. Built in Europe, GDPR-compliant, EU-hosted.

Centrium replaces the typical 4-tool staffing stack (Word + Notion + WhatsApp + manual PDFs) with one workflow covering the entire cycle from sourcing to paid invoice. Designed for staffing agencies of 10 to 500 consultants and consulting firms.

## Key facts

- Product: B2B SaaS platform for staffing agencies and consulting firms
- Publisher: QuadCore SAS (France)
- Hosting: European region (GDPR-compliant)
- Pricing: Custom quote within 48 hours, no public grid, 12-month minimum commitment
- Languages: French, English (toggle FR/EN on all public pages)
- Target audience: Business managers, recruiters, finance teams of ESN (Entreprises de Services du Numérique)

## Core modules

- **Consultants library** — centralized talent pool with AI CV parsing, skill/seniority/city search, real-time availability and bench alerts
- **CV Optimizer** — proprietary template with 3 variants (Standard, Dense, Executive), inline editing, PDF/DOCX export. Brand consistency across the entire library.
- **Matching & RFP** — AI extracts job specs from RFPs (screenshot or text), suggests top 3 profiles by fit score, generates branded job spec PDFs
- **Timesheets & Invoicing** — interactive timesheet calendar, automatic invoice generation with IBAN/VAT/legal mentions, late-payment alerts, Sage/Pennylane export

## Engineering principles

- Operations first: every screen designed with a real staffing agency in mind
- AI-assisted, not autonomous: AI suggests, you approve, never invents
- Compliance by default: EU hosting, multi-tenant Row Level Security, audit trail

## Security & compliance

- TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest
- Multi-tenant isolation via PostgreSQL RLS
- GDPR/CNIL compliant, DPA signable on request
- Daily encrypted backups with PITR (Point-in-Time Recovery)
- Logged access, sensitive action audit trail

## Contact

- Email: contact@centrium-platform.com
- Publisher: QuadCore SAS, France

## What Centrium is not

- Not an ATS (Applicant Tracking System) — it's for managing already-employed consultants, not hiring funnels
- Not a public job board — RFPs and missions stay private inside each agency
- Not an autonomous AI agent — AI suggests, humans approve every decision

## Versioning

Current version: v1 (post-MVP). Currently public-facing marketing site live; internal app gated by authentication. Public API not yet exposed.
